title: Dataset and graph summary
source: Canonical graph and corrected station model artifacts; data genealogy Volume 03

title: Corrected forecasting benchmark: v2j
note: Five-seed ensemble where available; MAE/RMSE in micrograms per cubic metre. Historical v2j weather information protocol; 14,583 paired test observations per horizon.

title: Cutoff-safe MLP and TCN benchmark: v2m
note: Five-seed mean-prediction ensembles. v2m weather aggregation differs from historical v2j ST-PIGNN; not identical-input ablations.

title: Directional physics ablation
note: Five-seed ensembles, 14,583 pairs/horizon. Negative ΔMAE favors directional. Seven-day intervals and Holm p refer to directional versus λ=0; Laplacian comparison is descriptive here. Hinge is not mass conservation.

title: W6 genuine held-out station results
note: Eleven scored sites; four sites had no test targets. MAE in micrograms per cubic metre. Pooled MAE 22.314 ST-PIGNN versus 20.624 weather/static ridge; station timestamps are dependent.

title: v2r spatial decoder held-out forecast comparison
note: Separate positive-lead-time task. Decoder underperforms forecast-IDW and station mean; not pooled with W6.

title: Experimental citywide computational execution
note: Six-hour targets; full runtime includes decoder fitting and maps. Per-snapshot expansion 1.12–1.30 s. Values are experimental neural-assisted estimates, not validated roadside predictions.

title: Corrected ST-PIGNN Captum verification
note: Units for delta and wrapper error are micrograms per cubic metre. v2c and v2r are different model protocols; neither is the missing v2j benchmark checkpoint.

title: Frozen original-field routing benchmark
note: Nine demand batches, 252 submitted requests/method. Matched percentages refer to corrected versus shortest on common admitted requests. Max utilization is a fraction. Modelled dose is not measured exposure.

title: Claim-to-evidence summary
source: v2l, W6, v2r, Captum, v2t verdicts
note: Classifications are bounded to completed Bengaluru evidence; no independent external replication.
